components.name: Button
components.summary: Runs an action when pressed, with variants, sizes and a loading state
components.description: Button starts an action: save, send, delete, open a dialog. Its `label` is both its text and its accessible name, and it can wait on an async action with `clickAction`. To open a menu use DropdownMenu.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible text and the accessible name. Name the outcome: "Save changes", not "OK".

props.name: variant
props.description: `primary` for the one main action in view, `destructive` for an action that loses data.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Drawn before the label; hidden from assistive tech, since the label names the button.

props.name: endContent
props.description: Drawn after the label: a count, a shortcut hint. Hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: width
props.description: `content` keeps its own width in a column; `fill` stretches across. Unset follows the parent.

props.name: disabledMessage
props.description: Why it is disabled: read as the button's description while disabled; not drawn.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a spinner and ignores presses; the button stays focusable and reports busy.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs on press, before `clickAction`.

props.name: clickAction
props.description: An async action, such as a Logic action. The button shows loading until it settles.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so its classes win over the recipe's.

accessibility.name: label
notes: A loading button stays enabled and focusable, reports busy, and ignores presses.
Sizes sm (32) and md (40) are below the 44 pt touch minimum; on touch layouts prefer lg until hit slop lets the press area extend past the paint.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Modal panel over the page for a decision or a short task
components.description: Dialog interrupts the page to ask for a decision or a short piece of input, and keeps focus and assistive tech inside until it closes. It is controlled: `isOpen` shows it, `onOpenChange(false)` reports every close request.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether it is shown. A closed dialog renders nothing, so local state inside starts over.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` on a close request: Escape, back, the backdrop per `dismissOn`, the close button.

props.name: label
props.description: The title, and the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Keeps `label` as the name without drawing it as a title.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the title, read as the dialog's description.

props.name: isAlert
props.description: Interrupts with something to confirm or acknowledge; screen readers announce it as an alert dialog. Pair it with `dismissOn="closeRequest"` or `"none"`.

props.name: children
props.description: The body; it scrolls when the panel reaches its maximum height.

props.name: actions
props.description: The footer, typically Buttons, the main action last.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Shows a close button in the header, named by this text.

props.name: dismissOn
props.description: Which requests close it: `any` adds a backdrop tap to `closeRequest` (Escape, back); `none` leaves closing to your code, for a step that must finish.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum width: 360, 480 or 640.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel.

accessibility.name: label

states.from: isOpen; announced as an alert dialog with isAlert

notes: Opened from a hardware keyboard, focus moves to the first control and returns to the opener on close; opened by touch, focus stays put.
Android back and the screen reader dismiss gesture are close requests, like Escape.
The close button is 32 px; it is below the 44 pt touch minimum until hit slop exists, so always offer an action button too.
